child.label: Family Rules of Thumb
child.description: Questions about how many people would agree with a general rule of thumb about family, parents, children, or siblings, rated from "practically no one" to "practically everyone".
child.not_for: Questions about what the answerer would do, prefers, or experienced in family life, or what most people would name (use Family Situations & Choices).
examples: How many people would agree: "Children are expected to respect their parents"?
How many people would agree: "It is okay to not get along with family members"?

child.label: Family Situations & Choices
child.description: Questions about how the answerer would handle or has experienced specific family situations, such as parenting decisions, sibling fights, aging parents, holidays, in-laws, and adult children at home.
child.not_for: Ratings of how many people would agree with a stated rule of thumb about family (use Family Rules of Thumb).
examples: Should parents let siblings settle their own fights?
Should adult children who move home pay rent?
